title: Press freedom and government spending efficiency
title_zh: 新闻自由与政府支出效率
authors: Bao We Wal Bambe, Jean-Louis Combes, Manegdo Ulrich Doamba, Chantale Riziki Oweggi
abstract: Abstract We examine the effect of media freedom on public expenditure efficiency using a panel of 134 advanced and developing countries from 1994 to 2016. Our findings provide robust evidence that greater media freedom significantly enhances government spending efficiency. This effect is more pronounced in countries with higher levels of democracy, per capita income, human capital, internet access, and strong fiscal rules. Furthermore, we show that media freedom primarily influences efficiency through reduced corruption, increased transparency and accountability in the public sector, and stronger electoral competition. These results underscore the vital role of media freedom in fostering good governance and efficient public resource allocation, particularly in a context where press freedom is declining and fiscal constraints are tightening.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文利用1994年至2016年间134个发达与发展中国家的面板数据，考察了媒体自由对公共支出效率的影响。研究结果提供了稳健证据，表明更高的媒体自由显著提升了政府支出效率。这一效应在民主水平更高、人均收入更高、人力资本更丰富、互联网接入更普及以及财政规则更严格的国家中更为显著。此外，我们证明媒体自由主要通过减少腐败、增强公共部门的透明度与问责制以及强化选举竞争来影响效率。这些结果凸显了媒体自由在促进善治和高效公共资源配置中的关键作用，尤其是在新闻自由日益受限、财政约束不断收紧的背景下。

title: Access Denied, Performance Declined: Information Access Barriers and the Multi‐Dimensional Export Competitiveness in China
title_zh: 访问受限，绩效下滑：信息获取壁垒与中国多维出口竞争力
authors: Kaihao Liu, Xue Lv, Cheng Zhang, Kun Zheng
abstract: ABSTRACT Utilising microdata from Chinese A‐share listed firms matched to the China Customs Database over the period 2007–2016, this paper exploits a quasi‐natural experiment based on Google's exit from mainland China and constructs a difference‐in‐differences (DID) model to systematically examine the impact of information access barriers on firms' multi‐dimensional export competitiveness. The results indicate that information access barriers have a significant negative effect on firms' multi‐dimensional export competitiveness, primarily reflected in narrowing export product scope, reducing export technological sophistication and weakening their centrality in the export trade network. Mechanism analyses reveal that information access barriers suppress firms' multi‐dimensional export competitiveness through multiple channels, including increasing transaction costs, constraining technological innovation, weakening capital investment, reducing productivity and aggravating financial constraints. Moreover, heterogeneity tests reveal that the impact of information access barriers on firms' multi‐dimensional export competitiveness varies significantly across regions, industries and firm types. Extending the scope beyond export performance, further analysis shows that restricted information access significantly impairs firms' short‐term profitability and long‐term market valuation. Taken together, this study underscores the critical role of information access barriers in firms' export competitiveness and upgrading, offering important insights for better leveraging information technology to improve export patterns.
abstract_zh: 利用2007–2016年中国A股上市公司与海关数据库匹配的微观数据，本文以谷歌退出中国大陆为准自然实验，构建双重差分模型系统考察信息获取壁垒对企业多维出口竞争力的影响。结果表明，信息获取壁垒对企业多维出口竞争力具有显著负向效应，主要表现为缩小出口产品范围、降低出口技术复杂度、削弱其在出口贸易网络中的中心度。机制分析显示，信息获取壁垒通过增加交易成本、抑制技术创新、削弱资本投入、降低生产率及加剧融资约束等多重渠道抑制企业多维出口竞争力。异质性检验表明，信息获取壁垒对不同地区、行业及类型企业的多维出口竞争力影响存在显著差异。将研究范畴拓展至出口绩效之外，进一步分析发现，信息获取受限显著损害企业短期盈利能力和长期市场估值。综上，本研究揭示了信息获取壁垒在企业出口竞争力与升级中的关键作用，为更好利用信息技术优化出口格局提供了重要启示。

title: Conditional Randomization Tests for the Specification of Interference Structure
title_zh: 干扰结构设定的条件随机化检验
abstract: ABSTRACT This study proposes specification tests for interference structure in causal inference with spillovers. We focus on experimental settings in which the treatment assignment mechanism is known. To test whether a given exposure mapping adequately summarizes the true interference structure, we develop conditional randomization tests by utilizing the hierarchical relationship between the null and alternative exposure mappings. When there are multiple candidate exposure mappings of interest, we propose a sequential specification testing procedure that controls the false discovery rate. Through extensive simulation exercises, we demonstrate that our tests have desirable size properties and satisfactory power. To illustrate the proposed methods, we revisit two existing social network experiments: One on farmers' insurance adoption and another on anti‐conflict education programs.
abstract_zh: 本研究针对存在溢出效应的因果推断中的干扰结构，提出了设定检验方法。我们聚焦于处理分配机制已知的实验场景。为检验给定的暴露映射是否充分概括了真实的干扰结构，我们利用零假设与备择假设暴露映射之间的层级关系，开发了条件随机化检验。当存在多个感兴趣的候选暴露映射时，我们提出了一种序贯设定检验程序，该程序能够控制错误发现率。通过大量模拟实验，我们证明所提出的检验具有理想的尺度性质与令人满意的检验功效。为说明所提方法的应用，我们重新审视了两项现有社交网络实验：一项关于农民保险采纳行为，另一项关于反冲突教育项目。

title: Peer Pressure: How Relative Debt Drives Emerging Market Sovereign Spreads
title_zh: 同伴压力：相对债务如何驱动新兴市场主权利差
authors: Carmen L Avila-Yiptong & Georges Hatcherian & Mahamoud Islam
official: 官方在线 2026-06-05 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper shows that sovereign bond spreads are shaped not only by absolute debt levels but also by a country’s relative debt position within its peer group. Using panel fixed effects for over 80 emerging and developing economies over 1993-2024, we find that relative debt—especially benchmarked by income and commodity status—has greater explanatory power for spreads than gross debt alone. A one–standard deviation increase in relative debt raises spreads by roughly 0.2–0.3 standard deviations, comparable in magnitude to global risk indicators. Similarly, a 10 percent increase in relative debt is associated with a 3.8 percent increase in sovereign spreads, all else equal. The effect of relative debt is state-dependent, being stronger in countries with better institutions, access to concessional lending, and during periods of low risk aversion and ample global liquidity. These results hold across alternative specifications, sample periods, methodologies, and controls, which underscores the comparative nature of investor assessments and the importance of benchmarking for fiscal policy, debt management, and international surveillance.
abstract_zh: 本文表明，主权债券利差不仅受绝对债务水平影响，还取决于一国在其同类国家中的相对债务位置。基于1993-2024年间80多个新兴经济体和发展中经济体的面板固定效应模型，我们发现相对债务——尤其是以收入和商品类别为基准衡量的相对债务——对利差的解释力强于总债务。相对债务每增加一个标准差，利差约上升0.2-0.3个标准差，其影响幅度与全球风险指标相当。类似地，在其他条件不变的情况下，相对债务每增加10%，主权利差将上升3.8%。相对债务的影响具有状态依赖性：在制度质量较高、可获得优惠贷款的国家，以及全球风险规避程度较低、流动性充裕的时期，其效应更为显著。上述结论在替代设定、样本区间、方法论及控制变量下均保持稳健，凸显了投资者评估的比较属性，以及基准化分析对财政政策、债务管理和国际监督的重要性。

title: Adam Smith and the role of the towns in feudal Europe
title_zh: 亚当·斯密与封建欧洲城镇的角色
abstract: Abstract Adam Smith’s account of medieval towns in Book III of The Wealth of Nations remains one of the most influential analyses of how commerce transformed feudal Europe. This paper formalizes Smith’s argument as a game between kings, lords, and towns. The king-town alliance emphasized by Adam Smith emerges when towns are wealthy enough to offer fiscal and military support but lords remain a serious threat. However, when kings become excessively predatory, towns may ally with lords (as in the Magna Carta crisis); when towns are too weak to offer substantial support, kings ally with lords instead (as in Eastern Europe). A dynamic extension shows that the king-town equilibrium is self-undermining: commercial growth erodes lordly military power through Smith’s “diamond buckles” mechanism, eventually enabling royal absolutism. In contrast, the king-lords equilibrium is self-reinforcing, suppressing urban development and preserving feudal institutions. The framework highlights how small differences in initial urban development could generate dramatically different long-run trajectories and illuminates both the brilliance and the limitations of Smith’s conjectural history.

title: Foreign Direct Investment and Maritime Transportation Infrastructure: Competition Effects Under the Belt and Road Initiative
title_zh: 外商直接投资与海上交通基础设施：“一带一路”倡议下的竞争效应
abstract: ABSTRACT In this paper, we analyse the determinants of maritime connections, with a special focus on the importance of foreign direct investments (FDI) in improving maritime transportation networks and in restructuring them. We are also interested in how China, in particular, impacts countries' integration to global supply chains through maritime transportation. We work on a heterogeneous panel of bilateral maritime connections as measured by UNCTAD's bilateral liner shipping connectivity index, and we find that FDIs between two partner countries do not significantly impact their maritime connection. However, we do find that Chinese FDIs in countries concerned by the Belt and Road Initiative (BRI) reinforce bilateral maritime connections between countries, in general, be they BRI countries or not. The Chinese influence is also significant via their maritime presence: maritime connections between two countries are significantly higher when host countries have strong maritime ties to China. A deeper analysis through several interaction effects also shows the Chinese influence is conditional on host countries' attributes. For instance, a maritime connection with China is more beneficial to developing/poorer host countries, who see their connection to origin countries increase more as compared to developed/richer host countries.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了海上连接的决定因素，特别关注外国直接投资在改善海上运输网络及其结构调整中的重要性。我们还重点研究了中国如何通过海上运输影响各国融入全球供应链。基于联合国贸发会议双边班轮航运连接指数衡量的异质性双边海上连接面板数据，我们发现两国之间的外国直接投资并未显著影响其海上连接。然而，中国在“一带一路”倡议相关国家的直接投资普遍加强了各国（无论是否为“一带一路”国家）之间的双边海上连接。中国的海上存在也产生了显著影响：当东道国与中国有紧密的海上联系时，两国之间的海上连接显著更高。通过多种交互效应的深入分析表明，中国的影响取决于东道国的特征。例如，与中国建立海上连接对发展中国家/较贫穷的东道国更为有利，这些国家与来源国的连接提升幅度大于发达国家/较富裕的东道国。
